purpose: Evidence-backed prompt memory for recurrent asset-generation rejection patterns. Entries guide candidate generation only; they never auto-promote assets.

entries.reason: cross-animation identity/headgear drift
entries.prompt_hint: Keep one identical rust-orange safety hard hat, face, dark jacket and rust-orange accents across all OP animations.

entries.reason: historical multi-subject walk frames
entries.prompt_hint: Exactly one worker only; never show a companion, duplicate, reflection or second body.

entries.reason: historical photorealistic style drift
entries.prompt_hint: Use stylized painterly 2.5D mobile game art, not a photograph or cinematic portrait.

entries.reason: clone/scale ladder
entries.prompt_hint: Force structural silhouette changes early; never represent tier progression by scaling the same circular mass.

entries.reason: oversized platform/site-card silhouette
entries.prompt_hint: Facility architecture must dominate the silhouette; avoid a broad square perimeter deck or site-card base.

entries.reason: radial starburst scale ladder across tiers
entries.prompt_hint: Do not preserve a pure circular starburst across tiers. Introduce large connected side pylons, vertical core stages and stepped massing so normalized silhouette changes early.

entries.reason: walk cycle preserves identity but lacks visible alternating stride
entries.prompt_hint: For WALK, exaggerate alternating left/right leg stride and arm counter-swing; the lower-body silhouette must visibly change frame to frame.

entries.reason: late-tier family discontinuity: T5 reverts from vertical nexus to flat radial disc
entries.prompt_hint: T5 and T6 must continue the vertical stepped T4 architecture; preserve a tall central core and fused side citadels, never revert to a flat radial disc.

entries.reason: tier ladder reads as scale/height clone with insufficient architectural evolution
entries.prompt_hint: Each BLD-04 tier must add obvious connected architecture: utility wings, automation core, second-storey blocks and late-game tower massing; never only scale or heighten the previous shell.

entries.reason: site/platform shadows, detached specks and pseudo-text contamination
entries.prompt_hint: Render one connected Mars complex only, with blank facades and no labels, people, vehicles, detached specks, platform deck, ground shadow or surrounding site.

entries.reason: legacy runtime family inconsistent; T6 includes platform/text contamination
entries.prompt_hint: Keep one coherent tech-company megastructure family. Preserve camera/material DNA; no platform card, pseudo-text, detached scene elements or abrupt family redesign.

entries.reason: legacy runtime family has large architecture drift across tiers
entries.prompt_hint: Preserve one lunar-colony family: connected domes/habitat blocks and utility masses, stable materials/camera, with gradual structural growth.

entries.reason: legacy Dyson family discontinuity with tiny T5 collapse
entries.prompt_hint: Keep a persistent stellar-energy hub and connected collector/ring systems at every tier; never collapse a late tier into a tiny isolated object.

entries.reason: legacy exchange family inconsistent with ground/platform contamination
entries.prompt_hint: Preserve one galactic exchange hub identity with connected logistics wings; no ground slab, cast shadow, detached scene, or unrelated tower redesign.

entries.reason: legacy gateway family loses dominant portal identity across tiers
entries.prompt_hint: Every tier must preserve one dominant gateway frame fused into connected service architecture; evolve massing without replacing the family identity.

entries.reason: legacy sheets show identity drift, crop fragments and inconsistent action silhouettes
entries.prompt_hint: Use one persistent TECH identity across all animations; full-body single subject in every frame; preserve cyan accents, graphite coveralls, head/hair and body proportions; reject torso-only or cropped frames.

entries.reason: legacy sheets show multi-subject frames, identity drift and inconsistent carried-object composition
entries.prompt_hint: Use one persistent LOG identity across all animations; exactly one worker; stable amber/black workwear; carried objects must stay attached to the same worker and never introduce a second person.

entries.reason: legacy sheets show identity drift, crop artifacts and weak action differentiation
entries.prompt_hint: Use one persistent ENG identity across all animations; full-body single subject; stable cyan engineering suit/head identity; enforce visibly different action poses without cropping or duplicate bodies.

entries.reason: site/platform/landscaping fused around office clone
entries.prompt_hint: Render only the headquarters building itself. No site slab, plaza, paths, trees, shrubs, benches, exterior lamps, cars, signs or freestanding outdoor objects. Change real connected architecture between tiers, not only scale.

entries.reason: family discontinuity T2→T3 plus generated text/logo contamination
entries.prompt_hint: Keep one persistent BLD-13 architectural DNA from T0 through T6: central vertical nexus with connected side pylons visible from early tiers. Never replace the radial early family at an anchor reset. No readable text, logos, watermarks, signage, pseudo-brand marks, detached debris, site slabs or baked ground shadows.
